title: SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2609.34335v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Achieving high-quality cinematic text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. Existing prompt enhancement (PE) methods and static cinematic skills offer limited capabilities for exploring diverse creative realizations. We propose SkillPE, a creativity-oriented PE framework that systematically evolves reusable cinematic skills through reference-guided exploration. Starting from expert-provided cinematic knowledge, SkillPE initializes and normalizes 20 structured seed skills. It then retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively inspiring near-misses). Resonators and dissonants refine skill applicability and execution, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations through controlled mutations that preserve user intent. translated_title: SkillPE：面向创造力的电影级技能演化用于文本到视频提示词增强
translated_abstract: 实现高质量的电影级文本到视频生成对非专业用户而言仍具挑战性，因为他们的提示词往往缺乏专业的叙事与创意设计。现有的提示词增强（PE）方法和静态电影级技能在探索多样化创意实现方面的能力有限。我们提出了 SkillPE，一个面向创造力的提示词增强框架，通过参考引导的探索系统性地演化可复用的电影技能。SkillPE 从专家提供的电影知识出发，初始化并规范化了 20 个结构化种子技能。随后，它检索电影参考并将其分类为共鸣者（良好匹配）、不和谐者（弱匹配）和分歧者（具有创意启发性的近似匹配）。共鸣者与不和谐者用于精炼技能的适用性与执行方式，而分歧者则通过保留用户意图的受控变异来激发替代性的电影实现方案。候选技能通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SkillPE 提出了一个面向创造力的提示词增强框架，通过从专家电影知识出发，利用共鸣、不和谐与分歧三类电影参考引导演化可复用的电影级技能，帮助非专家用户提升文本到视频生成的专业叙事与创意质量。
en_tdlr: SkillPE is a creativity-oriented prompt enhancement framework that systematically evolves reusable cinematic skills through reference-guided exploration of resonant, dissonant, and divergent movie references, enabling non-experts to achieve higher-quality text-to-video generation.
